## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D pixel-art fantasy RPG blending Skyrim and Dark Souls, with freedom of action, deep leveling and combat, many classes, magic types, armor, and weapons.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Aim for Stardew Valley-like pixel art and a Diablo-like HUD.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game in one HTML file, titled Ashenvale — The Hollow Crown.
- Chose three starter classes: Oathbound, Arcanist, and Warden; implemented keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game world, pixel-art canvas rendering, responsive HUD, character classes, movement, dodge, melee, three spells, potions, enemies, loot, leveling, attribute allocation, and gear upgrades.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Verified the game opens and starts in Playwright; latest console check reported zero errors and warnings.
- Saved and inspected the latest screenshot at `screenshots/ashenvale.jpg`.

- (none)

- (none)

1. If further work is requested, continue from `index.html`; optionally test combat, mobile controls, progression, and quest completion beyond the initial launch.

- `index.html`: Complete playable game implementation.
- `screenshots/ashenvale.jpg`: Latest inspected gameplay screenshot.

- Changes are not reported as committed or pushed.
